answer: Operator-Clawback Registration Freeze. Each new agent identity posts a timber-signed registration record binding it to an operator key. If independent verifiers flag a cluster of identities sharing an operator within a window, the protocol freezes that operator's entire ferrous resource quota and withholds all pending payouts for one epoch. Sybil operators therefore lose the full value of their existing fleet, not just the new wallets. Honest operators pay only a nectar-level deposit per cluster challenge they lose.
